# Security policy

## Supported versions

Canvink is currently a public alpha. Security fixes are provided for the latest
published version only.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/arturict/canvink/security/advisories/new)
to share the affected version, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested
mitigation. Reports are acknowledged as soon as practical. We will coordinate
disclosure after a fix or safe workaround is available.

The current trust boundaries, local data risks, and release controls are
documented in the [security model](../docs/security-model.md).
